statement.zh: **标准**：三重数据加密标准（Triple DES）。TDEA 的两次变换由附录直接印出。加密：「1.TDEA encryption operation: the transformation of a 64-bit block I into a 64-bit block O that is defined as follows: O = EK3(DK2(EK1(I))).」（把 64 位块 I 变换为 64 位块 O，定义为 O = EK3(DK2(EK1(I)))。）解密：「O = DK1(EK2(DK3(I)))」。密钥结构在第 48 行印出：「A TDEA key consists of three DES keys, which is also referred to as a key bundle.」（TDEA 密钥由三个 DES 密钥组成，也称为密钥束。）同行并说明单个 DES 密钥为 64 位、其中 56 位由算法直接使用、其余 8 位用于奇偶校验。公式的括号与下标按抽取件原样引用，未重排。
statement.en: **Standard**: Triple DES (三重数据加密标准).The two TDEA transformations are printed directly by the appendix.

statement.zh: 设计选择由第 371 行的三个密钥选项印出：「Keying Option 1: K1, K2 and K3 are independent keys」（三个密钥相互独立）、「Keying Option 2: K1 and K2 are independent keys and K3 = K1」（K1 与 K2 独立而 K3 = K1）、「Keying Option 3: K1 = K2 = K3」（三者相同）。同段给出向后兼容的条件，第 373 行印出其结果：「an encrypted plaintext computed using a TDEA mode of operation can be decrypted correctly by a corresponding single DES mode of operation.」（用 TDEA 模式算出的加密明文可被对应的单 DES 模式正确解密。）因此三选项与兼容性是同一设计取舍的两面，该条目目只陈述件内印出的选项与条件，不另行推断各选项的强度数值。
statement.en: The design choices are printed as three keying options at line 371: “Keying Option 1: K1, K2 and K3 are independent keys”, “Keying Option 2: K1 and K2 are independent keys and K3 = K1”, and “Keying Option 3: K1 = K2 = K3”.The same paragraph gives the backward-compatibility condition, and line 373 prints its consequence: “an encrypted plaintext computed using a TDEA mode of operation can be decrypted correctly by a corresponding single DES mode of operation.” The three options and that compatibility are two sides of one design trade-off; this entry states only the options and conditions the file prints and does not infer strength figures for each option.

statement.zh: 适用范围由第 12 条自己印出：「It applies to all Federal agencies, contractors of Federal agencies, or other organizations that process information (using a computer or telecommunications system) on behalf of the Federal Government to accomplish a Federal function.」（适用于所有联邦机构、其承包商，以及代表联邦政府完成联邦职能而处理信息的其他组织。）同条并说明各机构可依其数据安全需求判定发布内部使用指令。因此本行的用途陈述限于该标准自述的强制适用对象，不扩展为一般商业部署建议；具体的 TDEA 工作实例在成员行 algorithm--3des 与 algorithm--des。
statement.en: The applicability is printed by clause 12 itself: “It applies to all Federal agencies, contractors of Federal agencies, or other organizations that process information (using a computer or telecommunications system) on behalf of the Federal Government to accomplish a Federal function.” The same clause says each agency may issue internal directives based on its data-security requirement determinations.This row's usage statement is therefore limited to the standard's own stated mandatory audience and is not extended into general commercial deployment advice; concrete TDEA work instances live in the member rows algorithm--3des and algorithm--des.

statement.zh: 边界不是某次攻击而是标准本身已被废止，且这一状态由件内印出而非推断：第 4 行写「was withdrawn on May 19, 2005 and is provided here only for historical purposes」（于 2005 年 5 月 19 日废止，此处仅供历史目的提供）。同页紧接着给出相关去向：第 6 行指向 SP 800-131A（算法与密钥长度过渡建议），第 7 行指向 SP 800-67 Rev.1（TDEA 分组密码建议）。因此本行明确声明该标准已废止、只作历史文献，不构成任何现行使用建议；计划 V7 要求不得猜测标准是现行还是废止，此处正是引其印出句。
statement.en: The limit is not a particular attack but that the standard itself has been withdrawn, and that status is printed by the file rather than inferred: line 4 states it “was withdrawn on May 19, 2005 and is provided here only for historical purposes”.The same page immediately gives the onward references: line 6 points to SP 800-131A (transitioning cryptographic algorithms and key lengths) and line 7 to SP 800-67 Rev.

statement.zh: 断代坐标全部由件内印出。第 78 行：「This standard became effective July 1977.It was reaffirmed in 1983, 1988, 1993, and 1999.」（本标准于 1977 年 7 月生效，并在 1983、1988、1993 与 1999 年重新确认。）第 42 行的公告头印出「1999 October 25 Announcing the DATA ENCRYPTION STANDARD」。第 4 行给出终点：2005 年 5 月 19 日废止。因此本行陈述的是 1977 生效、四次重新确认、1999-10-25 公告版与 2005 废止这一条印出的时间线，不补充件内未印出的起草过程或竞争细节。
statement.en: Every dating coordinate is printed by the file.Line 78: “This standard became effective July 1977.
